page.overview:
What is Rusalka?

Rusalka is a town in Final Fantasy Dimensions.

The Warriors of Light come to this town on Bikke's ship in order to find a witch. Bikke tells them that he would be staying and shipping at the port in case the Warriors need to leave. Also, there is a strange bubbling coming up from the ocean. By asking people around the town, they know that a man named Eduardo is missing. The bartender in the town tells the Warriors to meet his friend, a man standing at the edge of the town. He tells them that there are some imperial soldier hiding out in the mountain to the northeast. The Warriors of Light then to there to investigate.

Going back from Mt. Rusalka, the Warriors take a rest inside the inn. At midnight, Sol wakes up and goes out. He sees a mysterious person(The Mask) who disappears almost immediately. Then he makes it to the dock and finds a frog that sings like a human. He follows it to a hole under the stairs, which lead to the town sewers. His companies wake up and tell him to go to sleep before investigating further.

In the morning, the party come to that hole again and they figures that only frogs can fit into it. Sarah turns everyone into frog and they go into the sewers. After Eduardo joins the Warriors, they decide to go and find Bottle of Bubbly Water, a legendary item that can help one to breathe underwater. Asking people around, they know that Gypsy, a merchant, and his family just left and headed to the Forest of the Fey. They decide to go there to find the item.
